## What's New in 0.1.7

### Compatibility & Stability
- Fixed `custom.hpk` (`hashpak.cpp`) on-disk serialization to use the exact 32-bit GoldSrc `hash_pack_entry_t` layout (144 bytes per entry instead of x64 152 bytes), preventing the `filesystem_stdio.dll` Line 147 (`ret == 0`) assertion crash when launching vanilla 32-bit `hl.exe` after `hnsru.exe`.
- Added directory and lump offset bounds validation in `hashpak.cpp` so legacy 64-bit `custom.hpk` files from older HNSRU versions are automatically detected and cleaned up on startup.
